summary: The exact candidate routes all-absent closed-wave charges through the existing typed unrecoverable skip without treating a fully archived wave as actionable, and the added tests cover both all-absent and archived-plus-absent cases. No introduced defect was found.

evidence: `src/host/modern-matrix-recovery.ts:519-524` now keeps a cell with no live or archived reservation actionable instead of returning an empty set, while still returning empty for a fully archived wave.

`src/host/modern-matrix-recovery.ts:608-614` reports every absent reservation id via `ClosedCWaveUnrecoverableSkipV1`, and `ingestClosedCWave` at lines 818-833 converts it to the typed `skipped` result with `reason=missing_reservation`.

`tests/host/modern-matrix-recovery-archive_test.ts:166-200` adds all-absent and archived-plus-absent cases that assert the typed skip and its missing ids; lines 202-224 preserve the fully archived no-op.

`src/host/matrix-aggregate.ts:227-232` defers the native proof-reader guard so the all-absent skip can complete without a reader, and `tests/host/matrix-consumer-own-wave_test.ts:157-169` exercises ordinary work continuing after that skip.
